dedupe_keys.name: glohydrores global hydropower plant and reservoir data set

description: GloHydroRes is a global data set that joins open hydropower plant data with reservoir data, so that the effects of drought and climate change on hydropower can be analysed. It was published on Zenodo in December 2024 by Jignesh Shah, Jing Hu, Oreane Edelenbosch and Michelle van Vliet. Existing open hydropower data usually lack reservoir information and reservoir data usually lack hydropower details; GloHydroRes combines them with 29 attributes, including installed capacity, plant type, head, dam height, reservoir depth, area and volume, and river name, for 7,775 hydropower plants in 128 countries. A separate file combines the data with inter-basin transfer schemes. Coverage is global. Files are CSV and Excel tables with a README, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: attributes are compiled from several open sources and are not complete for every plant, and the data are a 2024 snapshot. Simulation uses are drought and climate impact modelling of hydropower generation, reservoir operation studies and hazard exposure of dams and plants. Related records: data-gem-global-hydropower-tracker is a larger, regularly updated plant list, and data-us-federal-hydropower-projections-cmip5 gives climate projections for US plants.
